Electronics &
Appliances

Glimpse works with consumer electronics and home appliance brands across the region. These categories are won on product detail, price and availability, and the marketing has to work as hard in retail as it does online.

For brands and retailers in Qatar, we run product launches, seasonal and promotional campaigns, always-on social media in Arabic and English, search campaigns that capture buyers comparing models, and product photography and video built for e-commerce and in-store screens.

We track results by product line, so you can see which models and offers the campaigns are moving.
